title: DNF for an OR of literals over gate functions
statement: Fix natural numbers $m,n$ and a width bound $l$. Let $c_1,\dots,c_k$ be Boolean circuits on $m$ variables, each of which is a single literal, and let $N$ be the OR node whose children are exactly these circuits. Suppose that to each variable index $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,m$ there is associated a gate function $g_i$ taking a Boolean assignment $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \{0,1\}$ to a Boolean value, and that every $g_i$ is computed both by some DNF formula on the $n$ inputs of width at most $l$ and by some CNF formula on the $n$ inputs of width at most $l$. Then the composite function $x \mapsto N\bigl((g_i(x))_{i}\bigr)$ — the disjunction of the literal children evaluated at the gate values $g_i(x)$ — is itself computed by a DNF formula $\varphi$ on the $n$ inputs of width at most $l$, in the sense that $\varphi(x)$ equals the value of $N$ on the assignment $i \mapsto g_i(x)$ for every $x$.
hypotheses_covered: every child circuit in the list is a literal
each gate function g_i has a DNF of width at most l computing it
each gate function g_i has a CNF of width at most l computing it
the node is an OR node (Circuit.node false) over the children

Consider an OR node $\mathrm{Circuit.node}\,\mathrm{false}\,cs$ whose children are all
